entries: You speak to this as an individual. Why?
你们把此物当作个体交谈。为什么？
... one cannot do this. To do so would require volition. I do not have volition. I... I? I am...
……不可能如此。那样做需要意志。我没有意志。我……我？我是……
Affirmative. Yet, problem persists. The branches weaken and die.
确认。但问题仍在。枝条虚弱，正在死去。
I am learning not to judge by appearance. Your actions can set a new course.
我正在学着不以貌取人。你的行动能开出一条新的道路。
Unexpected inquiry. Insufficient answers. There is no fog.
意外的询问。答案不足。并不存在迷雾。
That is a destiny I would rather avoid.
这样的命运，我宁愿避开。
Do as @ has done. Be free.
Make own choices. If cannot change nature, then change direction.
自己做选择。改不了本性，就改方向。
This thing again? What is it?
The only destiny he has is with my blade.
他唯一的命运，就是撞上我的刀锋。
It is beyond the nature of this shell.
Are you not an individual? Do you not have your own thoughts?
你不是一个个体吗？你没有自己的思绪吗？
This entity was not intended to engage other entities. Unnecessary.
此实体无意与其他实体交涉。没有必要。
I doubt this will turn out well for anyone.
我怀疑这对谁都不会有好结果。
We seem to be destined to run into one another.
看来我们注定要一再相遇。
Perhaps, you are more than you believe. Give yourself a name.
也许，你比自己以为的更丰富。给自己起个名字吧。
Anomaly detected. Another spoiled harvest. Insufficient workers.
检测到异常。又一场腐坏的收割。劳力不足。
And what of the fog? What is it? What is its purpose?
那迷雾呢？它是什么？它的目的是什么？
